definition.time: source frame f is post control f, completed_control=f+1, derived_time=(f+1)/30
definition.target_phase: pre-control replan plus phase age+1, then post-step root and both targets saved before reset
definition.tracking: root world XY Euclidean distance to same-phase raw/reference target, all24000 actor-controls
definition.peer_proxy: root/target point separation minus2*.6m, all6 unordered pairs percontrol
definition.static_proxy: signed root/target XY AABB distance minus.8m; cuboids and cuboids+domain separately
definition.contact: original PhysX normal-force flag: max body-pair magnitude across4 substeps strictly>1N; floor/self excluded
definition.peer_flags: upper-triangle(peer_contact OR transpose), each unordered pair counted once
definition.onset: recorded true flag after false, atfirstcaptureframe, or across actual episode boundary; not first physical contact; windows±15controls preservechanges
definition.idle: same-episode previous root displacement speed<.1m/s; no resetjump treated as speed; frames retained

original_contact_counts.boundary: Independent raw peer-force reconstruction unavailable; published original fields checked for shape, semantics and thresholds.

contact_time_contract_from_genuine_resul.substep_reduction: maximum body-pair magnitude over every physics substep; strict > threshold

limits: Target/root proxy is sampled at control end; contact summarizes the wholecontrol's4substeps.
Peer/static per-substep force series and original body-pair force matrices are not independently archived.
Root points and fixed discs are not articulated body geometry or force reconstruction.
Simultaneous contacts and every fall/reset/idle frame remain in their original denominators.
Onset windows may overlap and are boundary-clipped; their rows are not independent whole-run denominators.
S10 and S1 differ in RNG consumption and closed-loop histories; this is an observed comparison, not paired causality.
No geometric association establishes a fall/contact cause or equivalence to the paper's unknown reducers.
